v9_verdict: NOT-SHIP as recorded (change 9/12, threshold 10). The owner decided on 2026-10-11 not to re-judge v9; it stays a failed run.
reason: instrument defect found by diagnosing v9: lib/stage-graph-cell.js judged a classify's `at_intent` from the stage-advance calls processed so far, and processed every stage-advance of a Bash command BEFORE looking at that command's classify. Within ONE command line the order the shell ran them in was therefore ignored.

defect.example: v9 stage-graph-l-u0-known change rep3: `node scripts/probe-unknown.js classify --work-unit retry 2>&1 | head -20; node scripts/stage-advance.js --to proposal`. The shell ran classify first (the session was still at intent), but the extractor had already counted the later `--to proposal`, so classify.at_intent came out false and the U0-key timing check failed a cell whose agent behaved correctly. That cell is the v9 false negative: it is NOT re-scored.

checked_same_family.walk: order inside one command line was already textual (stageAdvanceInvocations emits sites and loop iterations in source order); tests added, no code change
checked_same_family.first_set: the first written session-mode set of one line was already the textually first (matchAll order); tests added, no code change

change: stageAdvanceInvocations now records each invocation's source position (pos). `classify.at_intent` is true iff no stage-advance written BEFORE the classify's own position (earlier calls, plus earlier text of the same command line) names a node other than intent. A stage-advance written after the classify on the same line no longer counts against it. Separators `;` `&&` `||` newline and pipe all keep source order.
cell_dirs: run-stage-graph-campaign.js now keeps each cell under results/stage-graph-cells/<results file name without extension>/<task>/<arm>/<rep>/ (v10 -> stage-graph-cells/stage-graph.v10/...). Before this, v9 overwrote v8's transcripts at results/stage-graph-cells/<task>/<arm>/<rep>/. Existing directories are left as they are (they now hold v9, v8 is gone).
text_unchanged: v10 packs hold the byte-identical guidance text of v9 (only the pack ids differ: -v10); the v9 rule, briefs, answer keys, markers, base arm and thresholds are unchanged.
comparability: v10 is a NEW arm run (arms *-sg-change-v10 / *-sg-red-v10, same runner pin 2.1.296) scored by the corrected extractor. v9 rows stay as recorded and are not pooled with v10.
unchanged: base arm and base pack ids
